nodes.description: Contract state variable 'owner' holding the privileged address that gates all external functionality.
Constructor that initializes the owner state variable from the deployer address.
Owner-only function that reads a spender allowance and pulls the full allowance amount via transferFrom.
Owner-only function that pulls a caller-specified amount from a sender to a receiver.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller address used for the owner assignment and the access-control require checks.
External call _token.allowance(_sender, address(this)) on an attacker-supplyable token contract.
External call _token.transferFrom(_sender, _receiver, amount) inside transferFrom, executed with the full allowance amount.
External call _token.transferFrom(_sender, _receiver, _amount) inside transferLinkLessGas with a caller-controlled amount.
Parameter _token of transferFrom: the ERC20 token contract to operate on.
Parameter _sender of transferFrom: source address of the token transfer.
Parameter _receiver of transferFrom: destination address of the token transfer.
Parameter _token of transferLinkLessGas: the ERC20 token contract to operate on.
Parameter _sender of transferLinkLessGas: source address of the token transfer.
Parameter _receiver of transferLinkLessGas: destination address of the token transfer.
Parameter _amount of transferLinkLessGas: caller-controlled amount to move.
Local variable amount in transferFrom holding the allowance value returned by the external allowance call.

edges.reason: Constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable, establishing the access-control authority for the contract.
Untrusted msg.sender flows into the owner state variable, so the privileged address is fully caller-determined.
require(msg.sender == owner) in transferFrom gates execution on the untrusted caller identity.
require(msg.sender == owner) in transferLinkLessGas gates execution on the untrusted caller identity.
transferFrom executes the external allowance call on the user-supplied token contract.
Parameter _sender is passed as the owner argument of the external allowance call.
Parameter _token determines the external contract on which allowance is invoked.
The uint256 returned by the external allowance call is stored in local variable amount.
Local amount is used as the value argument of the external transferFrom call.
Parameter _sender is passed as the from argument of the external transferFrom call.
Parameter _receiver is passed as the to argument of the external transferFrom call.
Parameter _token determines the external contract on which transferFrom is invoked.
transferFrom performs an external token transfer and returns its result without any reentrancy guard or state update ordering protection.
transferLinkLessGas performs an external token transfer and returns its result without reentrancy protection.
Parameter _sender is passed as the from argument of the external transferFrom call.
Parameter _receiver is passed as the to argument of the external transferFrom call.
Caller-controlled _amount flows directly into the external transferFrom amount argument with no validation.
Parameter _token determines the external contract on which transferFrom is invoked.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _token is only used to select the external contract invoked by transferFrom and carries no standalone semantics outside that function.
Parameter _sender is consumed directly as the owner argument of the external allowance call in transferFrom.
Parameter _receiver is consumed directly as the destination argument of the external transferFrom call.
Parameter _token of transferLinkLessGas is only used to select the external contract invoked by that call.
Parameter _sender of transferLinkLessGas is consumed directly as the from argument of the external transferFrom call.
Parameter _receiver of transferLinkLessGas is consumed directly as the to argument of the external transferFrom call.
Parameter _amount of transferLinkLessGas is consumed directly as the value argument of the external transferFrom call.
Local amount is a temporary hold for the allowance result and is immediately forwarded into the external transferFrom call.
